Definition

The value of national currency against foreign currency. This refers to the reference rate of the MMA, showing the end of period mid rate of Maldivian Rufiyaa (MVR) per US Dollar (US$).

        Notes

            Data from 11 April 2011 refers to the MMA daily reference rate, which is the mid point of the weighted average buying and selling rates of all commercial banks.

Definition

The value of national currency against foreign currency. This refers to the reference rate of the MMA, showing the end of period mid rate of Maldivian Rufiyaa (MVR) per US Dollar (US$).

        Notes

            Data from 11 April 2011 refers to the MMA daily reference rate, which is the mid point of the weighted average buying and selling rates of all commercial banks.
